saw_lines: People grab a throat lozenge when a cough starts, then rebuy the same pack for the whole season.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, when a buyer decides if this pack is for them.
Your 25 live Meta ads carry no proof number, so collect one real figure like a review count or orders shipped and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 25 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have nothing concrete to trust before they click. Collect one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and print it on the next batch of ads.
0 of 25 ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act. Open the next ads with a first order offer or a bundle, stated in the opening line before anyone scrolls past.

20 different openings across 25 ads, and the biggest, “good vibes echo in harmony”, leads 5 of them. Spread that thin, nothing builds recognition. Pick the best two openings and build the next batch from them, one new ad per angle.
Your 12 Watch more ads send people to YouTube and 8 others to your Instagram profile. Point the Watch more ads at the Produkte page on ricola.com and add a button to the 5 ads with no call to action.
